Alex M.: quick payroll/tax q — was on CA payroll Jan–Aug then seconded to UK in Sep. I split my direct deposit (US acct + UK acct). Will I still get a single W-2 for 2026? Do we handle state withholding automatically for midyear moves or do I need to update forms (W-4/state) to avoid double withholding? Also does a midyear move affect 1095-C/benefits reporting?

Emily (People Ops): Congrats on the secondment! Short answers: you will receive one US W-2 for any US wages. State withholding depends on the address & tax elections we have on file — we don’t automatically switch you to the new state unless you submit a change. Please update your address and state withholding in the payroll portal asap. 1095-C: if you stayed enrolled in Redwood benefits for any part of the year you’ll get one for that coverage period.

PJ (Payroll): Adding payroll detail — if payroll still has a CA residence on file we will continue CA withholding. To change: go to Payroll Portal > Tax Forms and submit the state change (and a new W-4 if applicable). If you became a nonresident CA, we'll mark you accordingly but you may still owe CA nonresident tax depending on days worked here. We reconcile at year-end.

Alex M.: thanks — do you need anything from me to avoid CA withholding for Sep–Dec?

PJ (Payroll): Please provide the effective date of your move and a copy/photo of your UK proof of residence (utility bill or rental agreement) if you want us to treat you as moved for withholding purposes. Also confirm whether payroll should keep US wages paid in USD only (we'll pay to your UK bank via international transfer if that's what you set up).

Samira K.: And re benefits/1095-C — if you were on Redwood medical at any point this year you’ll still get a 1095-C showing coverage months. If you moved and enrolled in local UK coverage through relocation, we can annotate that in your file but the 1095-C is strictly for US employer-sponsored coverage.

payroll-bot: Payroll portal activity: new bank account added for Alex M. on 2026-03-17 12:14 UTC. Link: https://payroll.redwood.internal/portal (internal).

Emily (People Ops): Quick checklist for you, Alex — please:```
1) Update address in People Ops profile
2) Add/confirm bank accounts in Payroll Portal > Profile > Bank accounts
3) Submit State Withholding Change in Payroll Portal > Tax Forms
4) Upload proof of UK residence to the relocation folder or DM to me
```I can schedule a short call with payroll/tax if you want treaty or PAYE guidance — Redwood covers relocation tax consults. @PJ please flag Alex for year-end reconciliation.

PJ (Payroll): Flagged for year-end review and reconciliation. We’ll run a draft W-2/withholding estimate in November so you can see any expected state adjustments. :white_check_mark:

Alex M.: awesome — thanks everyone, I’ll upload the docs today.
